name: Spicy Cajun Shrimp, Sausage & Veggie Sauté with Mashed Cauliflower

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
6 sticks celery
3 orange bell peppers
3 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 0.68 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with about 2-inches of hot water from the tap; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem; roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Cut sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy and cooked through, 7-9 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the pot.
While the sausages are cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the celery.

When the sausage is done, return the pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the pot is hot, add veggies, tomatoes, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans diced tomatoes
2 tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp paprika
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp thyme, dried
½ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower is done, drain in a clean colander. Working in batches if necessary, transfer to a blender along with cream cheese, butter, and spices; purée until smooth. Return to the pot, cover, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block cream cheese
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add sausage and shrimp to the pot; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is warm and shrimp are cooked through, 3-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the pot with the shrimp-sausage sauté and stir to combine (reserve the other half for serving).
To serve, divide cauliflower mash and shrimp-sausage sauté between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
